_comment: Steps GitHub runs on Unite-Group PRs that cannot be reproduced on a macOS laptop. Every entry says why. Each one is a place where local green does not predict GitHub green, so keep the list short and the reasons checkable.

exempt.reason: runs-on: windows-2025. The Windows fail-fast runtime contract needs a Windows runner and PowerShell; it cannot run on macOS. KNOWN GAP: only GitHub checks it.
Runs inside a node:24.18-alpine linux/amd64 container to prove the musl build. Not reproducible on macOS arm64 without emulation. KNOWN GAP: only GitHub checks it.
Uses the gitleaks/gitleaks-action GitHub Action, which only runs on an Actions runner. KNOWN GAP: git-history secret scanning happens on GitHub only for this repo.
Gated on vars.E2E_ENABLED and needs the E2E_SUPABASE_* repository secrets, which are not available locally. KNOWN GAP when the variable is on.

Starts the repo's Supabase project on fixed port 54322 (config.toml project unite-spine). On this Mac that project is already running as a long-lived local stack, so 'supabase start' reuses it instead of starting an ephemeral one, and the migrations, seed and destructive idempotency suite would run against a database that is not disposable. KNOWN GAP: spine DB migrations and integration tests are checked on GitHub only; type-check still runs here.
